NUMBERING STRATEGY CLARIFICATION
================================================================================

Per session 2026-09-16 clarification (spec.md §Clarifications):

Numbering Strategy Decision:

- PRESERVE current specs (001-012) exactly as-is
- START new specs at 013 (not at highest+1 in range)
- FUTURE numbering rule: next = highest current + 1

Implementation:

- Current highest: 013 (our audit spec)
- Next specification: 014
- Subsequent: 015, 016, 017, etc.

Rationale:

- Maintains historical traceability (no renumbering of existing specs)
- Enables predictable future numbering (mechanical assignment)
- Preserves chronological ordering (new specs get incrementally higher numbers)

Evidence: Specification 013 created as first post-012 specification.
